title: NASA PSI-99: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II (Saffire-II), experimental table
method: Downloaded from the PSI API and saved unchanged (1,973 bytes of UTF-8, SHA-256 above). The loader reads a burn length of '~ 0' as no spread, and a length in cm, or 'Complete', as burned. A blank material cell repeats the row above, as the table is laid out. NASA's microgravity column headers read '?-g': the µ was lost in NASA's own file.
verification: Sample counts and published cells are checked by test/saffire.test.mjs. Second-person check pending.
limitations: A separate, larger experiment inside an uncrewed Cygnus, with 29 cm samples and the airflow running with the flame. It is shown beside answers and never pooled into a verdict.
Oxygen is 'Derived from measured CO2 production and referenced to initial O2 concentration reported by ISS' (Note 1), not measured directly. The cabin pressure isn't in the table.
Rows F1C1/F1C2 and F2C1/F2C2 are flow-visualisation data, and the Note rows are notes, not samples.
